plugins.name: bend-spec
plugins.description: Spec-first work for Bend projects traced by bolt: audit a project and roll out proofs until SPEC.md is trace-checked, then add features as SPEC.md row, quantified tagged law, proof, trace; speed one up without weakening a law.

plugins.name: bend-fleet
plugins.description: Upgrade ez-managed Bend packages to each other's latest releases, one package or the whole fleet: bump deps leaves first, release, publish to the hub by hash, update flake ez and [tools.bolt] pins, and verify READMEs as a plain Bend user.
